purpose: Classify known and unknown Goofish/Xianyu pages into safe read, redacted read, user-context, static-only, shell-boundary, or stop categories.

stopPoints: operate external page without separate review

stopOn: operate external page without separate review

unknownDecisionTree: Normalize domain, path, hash, and parameter names. Do not store raw private parameter values.
Try exactKnownPageRules. If matched, use the matched page ontology and verification checklist.
If exact match fails, detect surface from domain: www, seller, h5/app bridge, or unknown external.
Apply parameterRiskRules before any DOM probing. Parameter risk can upgrade a public-looking page to context-required.
Apply routeFamilyRules by path/hash prefix to infer family and default gate.
Wait only for safe structural anchors. Then apply domSignalRules if route is still ambiguous.
Apply stateModalRules. Login, permission, QR, confirm, file/export, and high-risk business states stop the probe.
If no rule matches, create an UNKNOWN_PAGE observation with route shape, surface guess, visible structural labels, and stop reason only.

unknownFallback.inferredGate: G4 until a safer family is proven

unknownOutputSchema.routeShape: path/hash shape with private values removed
unknownOutputSchema.nextAction: safe-read | read-with-redaction | needs-user-context | static-only | shell-boundary | stop
